verdict.rationale: Evidence shows ChatGPT can search the web, browse and compare multiple sources, summarize findings, and surface citations in-chat (chatgpt-docs-90, chatgpt-docs-86, chatgpt-docs-9, chatgpt-docs-49), and can turn research into a drafted report/document (chatgpt-docs-66, chatgpt-docs-68). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'Deep Research' autonomous long-running multi-source research mode with a structured cited report output, nor independent corroboration of its depth or accuracy for research tasks. Missing for 10: explicit deep-research/autonomous-multi-source-run documentation, evidence of report length/citation density, and independent hands-on validation of research quality.
